runtime_profile.held_visual_loss: closed jaw; no phase/release advancement; fault after held_red_loss_fault_ms

pseudo_labels.limitation: No explicit phase labels exist; pre-transport means strictly before pickup-close, where transport is physically impossible. Shallow threshold chatter is not treated as a phase transition.
pseudo_labels.source: four canonical action[6] threshold crossings with hysteresis

removed_feature.name: jaw_joint1.pos
removed_feature.runtime_authority: jaw must be controlled independently; this dataset emits no jaw action

rewritten_metadata: data/**/*.parquet Arrow and Hugging Face schemas

red_contour_diagnostics.definition: Contours after configured red HSV, morphology, and excluded ROIs; ambiguity candidates meet red_ambiguity_area_fraction_min. bbox_norm is left/top/width/height.

tip_probe.limitation: The 50 demonstration episodes are visual envelopes only. The pinned historical ACT exposes real pre-fix jaw and TCP behavior and drives a schema-v6 arm6 axis-authority replay. Pre-takeover policy numeric state/action contain J1-J6 only; jaw pixels may remain visible to the VLM but there is no numeric policy jaw input or output. Pre-takeover policy arm motion and TCP descent remain allowed and are not described as whole-pipeline zero motion. Hardware response to the counterfactual open command remains unvalidated.

negative_control.limitation: The historical trace proves the visual boundary and supplies real adversarial pre-fix jaw/TCP behavior. The schema-v6 arm6 adapter and the deployed VisualLatchRuntime composer replay command authority; no counterfactual hardware response or closed-loop convergence is claimed.

runtime_authority_replay.limitation: Pure software composition replay; it verifies command ownership and state transitions, not controller or hardware response. Runtime arm_owner is required to remain hold and every post-takeover arm target must equal the accepted reference exactly.
